frontmatter.aat-event-body: From this day, the walking gods of the Kanirûl were never seen nor heard from again, marking the second most formative day in the history of the sacred isles and becoming known simply as **The Departure**.
Wars fought between new nations of the sacred isles, severely diminishing the populations of select species. Commonly called the Thinning.

~"The Birth"~
A great disturbance in the cosmos; the mass influx of the sapient species to Kanyiirah and with them, a new host of lesser gods known as the [[Kanirûl Pantheon]].
The legend of Rukhzar Mao and the final confrontation with the Divine Titan, Caelaistra
Estimated to be when founding lineages of the modern day Idanthi came into prominence
The Anarûl manifested great Titans to fulfill their will upon the sphere are carve the Sacred Isles into a paradise that reflected the greatest Kanyiirah had to offer
After he was blessed by the will of Asteria, Aesuhir ascended to a new form of minor deity, calling himself the First [[Gilded Order|Empyrean]] and changing his name to **Aethmi-Istar**
Without the guidance of their god, the thinly balanced society of [[Yggrāhkærn]] collapsed in on itself in less than 1000 years

frontmatter.aat-event-title: Sounding of Harmony at the universal Origin
frontmatter.aat-event-body: When Chaos Fractured and the [[Family of the Endless|Endless]] emerged
